description: Why a stock or coin is in the news: the most-covered story naming it in the window, with its outlet count and timeline, and the next two stories. Use it for "is anyone covering Rio Tinto today?", "why is Tesla in the news?" or "what happened with Solana?". It says what the press is covering, not why a price moved, and says so plainly when there are no stories. Example: symbol "RIO", window "24h".

symbol.description: A ticker, coin code, CoinMarketCap ID, ISIN or CIK
